From {{inh|en|enm|flag}}, {{m|enm|flagge||flag}}, further etymology {{unc|en|nocap=1}}. Cognate with {{cog|frr|skut||the fold of a garment, lap, coattail}}, {{cog|fy|skoat||sheet; sail; lap}}, {{cog|nl|schoot||the fold of a garment, lap, sheet}}, {{cog|nds-de|Schote||a line from the foot of a sail}}, {{cog|de|Schoß||the fold of a garment, lap}}, {{cog|da|skød||lap, skirt}}, {{cog|is|skaut||the corner of a cloth, a line from the foot of a sail, the skirt or sleeve of a garment, a hood}}, {{cog|no|skaut||headdress}}, {{cog|sv|sköt||sheet}}.
